title: A man falls from a hotel window on Telegraph Avenue

tellings.quote: >> Because when I look up three stories up there's an open window with a curtain blowing and they jumped.

plain: In the late 1970s, on Telegraph Avenue in Berkeley, California, someone jumped from a hotel window three stories up. A man named Brent Friedman, a guest on an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, says he saw it: he looked up and saw an open window with a curtain blowing. He tells it as a moment he witnessed himself and never forgot.
